intro: Splinterspear Junction is a strategic fork in the main road winding through the heart of the Swamp of Sorrows. Dominated by a rugged orc watchtower and regularly patrolled by Horde sentries, it divides the path between northern retreats and southern outposts.

p: Standing near the center of the Swamp of Sorrows, Splinterspear Junction divides travelers between two paths: the northern trail leading toward the Lost One refuge of the Harborage and the Fallow Sanctuary, and the southern road running directly past the fortress of Stonard toward the Blasted Lands. An ancient orcish watchtower oversees the split, garrisoned and patrolled by active Horde troops. For members of the Horde, it serves as a secure landmark in a treacherous marsh; for Alliance travelers, it represents a deadly ambush point along an already unforgiving trail.

Long before the current watchtower was manned, this spot held bitter military significance. During the First War, an orcish encampment known as Kyross was established here, serving as the closest Horde strongpoint threatening the human settlement of Grand Hamlet. Stormwind repeatedly dispatched strike forces into the swamp to eradicate the outpost. Among those who perished in the skirmishes was Lieutenant Blake Godwyn, a knight from Lordaeron whose remains and ancestral sword were swallowed by the mire.
